How it works

Booked in 3 minutes. Gone in a day.

The whole process is online. No phone tag, no in-home estimates, no surprise on-site upcharges for the scope you book. Just pick your item, enter your ZIP, and a Loader handles it.

01

Get your price online

Enter your ZIP and pick the items going. Your guaranteed price displays immediately — no waiting for a callback, no in-home estimates.

02

Pick a pickup window

Same-day if you book before 2PM EST, next-day default everywhere. Choose a 4-hour window that works for you.

03

Card charged at booking. No in-person charges, no surprise on-site upcharges for the scope you book, no surprise fees. The price you book is guaranteed for the scope you book.

04

Loader handles it

An independent local Loader arrives in window, lifts the couch from any room, and routes it through local partners for donation, recycling, or compliant disposal.

Common questions

How couch removal actually works.

Couch removal starts at $90 for a standard couch. Sectionals start at $150, sleeper sofas at $110, recliners at $90. Final pricing depends on your ZIP and floor access. Disassembly and stairs are included when noted at booking — no surprise charges.
Couch Disposal Plus operates in all 50 states. Pickup availability and timing varies by metro — most major cities support same-day or next-day pickup, with some far-rural ZIPs scheduled within a week.
Same-day pickup is available in most cities when you book before 2PM EST. Next-day pickup is the default everywhere we operate. Average time from booking to pickup nationwide is around 24 hours.
Couches in donatable condition are routed to local 501(c)(3) charity partners — Habitat for Humanity ReStore, Salvation Army, Furniture Bank affiliates, and Goodwill local chapters. Items that can't be donated are taken to material recovery facilities for recycling; only what can't be salvaged goes to compliant disposal.
Couch Disposal Plus is an online platform operated by LoadUp Technologies. Pickups are performed by independent local Loaders — background-checked, insured contractors who operate their own businesses and accept jobs through the platform. The platform handles your booking, scheduling, payment, and customer support; the assigned Loader performs the in-person pickup and disposal.
